The Partition Sum Itself

Source: R/reparametrize.R
chain_derivatives.Rd

Carries the parent's derivatives into new coordinates, given the jets of the map. Separated from reparam_chain so that a family written in its own right, rather than obtained through reparametrize, can use the same machinery instead of a second copy of it.

Usage

chain_derivatives(parent, y, th_par, maps, new_params, order, expected = FALSE)

Arguments

parent

The distribution whose derivatives are being carried.

y

The response.

th_par

The parent's parameters, as plain numbers.

maps

The keyed partial tables of the map, as reparam_tables returns them.

new_params

The names of the new parameters.

order

The derivative order, 1 to 4.

expected

Logical; if TRUE, carries the expected derivatives.

Value

A named list of component vectors.

See also

reparametrize
